preservationPolicy: Preserve the approved spaced PNG byte-identical at 2528x682 with all original transparency. Do not crop, rescale, redraw, repack, activate or change gameplay without future explicit approval.
notes: Reserved only. Do not replace the active basic ice effect (casting-ice plus ice-shards-v26), or reserved Gelo 2–5. The source PNG is not a grid of constant-width frames; an eventual runtime animator must use the rectangles here and a duration explicitly decided later.
